title: Verified skill installation
description: Acquire and validate an explicitly selected compatible skill candidate and apply only the permitted destination-unit changes with truthful plans, conflicts, outcomes, and recovery limits.
responsibilities: Verify trusted package metadata, archive identity, extraction boundaries, and candidate completeness before relying on content.
Preflight all selected destination units and apply only authorized creation or replacement while preserving unrelated content.
Distinguish preliminary dry-run information, complete preflight, actual effects, conflicts, partial failure, and privacy-safe diagnostics.
owned_state: Transient verified candidate staging and the explicitly selected installed units affected by a request; no managed project-state adoption or whole-project ownership.

includes: Supported target installation and explicitly scoped replacement under the existing Installation contract.
excludes: Automatic upgrades, managed-state creation, bypassing integrity with force, replacing shared installation parents, or granting workflow authority.

design_limits: Current Installation rules retain the exact supported targets, trusted acquisition channels, conflict units, flags, diagnostics, and per-unit partial-failure guarantees.
The draft does not promise whole-project atomic rollback or add a remote service. ARs and implementation mapping remain deferred.

sources.basis: Proposed responsibility derived from the published-product source inventory. Existing Designs retain their detailed contracts; this allocation is not a runtime migration or approval.
